color.note: iOS inset-grouped palette with one warm tint. Light is the primary theme; Dark follows the system and uses a true-black page.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind grouped cards: the sheet itself. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-secondary`, `tint`.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Inset grouped cards and their rows. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-secondary`, `tint`, `destructive`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Anything floating above a card: menus, popovers, a floating action bar. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-secondary`, `tint`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `surface`, `surface-card` and `surface-raised`. 21:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `surface`, `surface-card` and `surface-raised`: section titles, row values, placeholders, scale labels. At least 5.4:1 in light and 7:1 in dark.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: 0.5px hairlines between rows. Decorative only: never the sole cue for a state or a boundary a control depends on.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: The single accent: text buttons, the primary button fill, selected check marks, the severity slider and selected body regions. As text on `surface` 4.8:1 and on `surface-card` 5.3:1 in light; 8.2:1 and 6.6:1 in dark.

tokens.name: on-tint
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `tint` fill (the primary button). White in light (5.3:1), near-black in dark (7.5:1): never literal white on the dark tint.

tokens.name: tint-soft
tokens.usage: Fill of preset chips and quiet highlights. Always paired with `on-tint-soft` text.

tokens.name: on-tint-soft
tokens.usage: Text on `tint-soft`: 5.5:1 in light, 8.9:1 in dark.

tokens.name: figure-fill
tokens.usage: Body-map base shapes, drawn on `surface-card`. Decorative: regions are also named in the list beside the figure.

tokens.name: figure-line
tokens.usage: Spine dots drawn over `figure-fill`. Decorative.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard and Switch Control focus outline, 3px solid with a 2px offset. At least 4.7:1 on `surface`, `surface-card` and `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Delete and discard actions only, as text or an icon on `surface-card` (6.5:1 light, 7:1 dark). Always paired with a word, never colour alone.

type.note: The app uses the system font (SF Pro on iOS) at Dynamic Type sizes; do not ship a font file. Inter is loaded only so previews outside Apple devices look close.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Top of a scrolling screen (Report, History). Not used inside sheets.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Screen sub-headings and the working product name.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Navigation titles, the primary button label, emphasised row values.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Row labels, text buttons in the navigation bar, note text. The default.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Supporting sentences under a row or in an empty state.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Chip labels and section titles above inset cards.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Helper text and slider end labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps inside dense lists and chart axes.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: A single computed number, such as a BASDAI result. Set with tabular digits.

spacing.note: 4pt grid. Screen margins are space-4; card padding is space-3 to space-4.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; gap between a section title and its card.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between figure and list inside a card; vertical gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margins, row side padding, card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Large gaps between groups on a screen.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap above a bottom-pinned button.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section breaks on long screens.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of any tappable control.

radius.note: Inner radius = outer radius minus the padding between them, so nested shapes stay concentric.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small inner elements such as a selected segment.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Text fields that sit outside a card.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Inset grouped cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips and the primary button: always a full capsule.

shadow.note: The UI is flat. Only floating surfaces cast a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and a floating action bar on `surface-raised`. Never on cards.
